notes: AGRANA Beteiligungs-AG (Vienna: AGR) — Austrian diversified agribusiness with three segments: Fruit (largest, ~50% revenue, fruit preparations + concentrates), Sugar (CEE beet sugar + Hungerburg/Tulln refineries), and Starch (food, technical, bioethanol). Fiscal year ends Feb 28/29. Reports in EUR. Volatile sugar segment (EU sugar deregulation 2017+, energy/beet costs 2022-23). Strong recovery FY24 from energy normalization. Listed on Vienna Stock Exchange (Wiener Börse).

periods.notes: FY20/21 (ended Feb 28 2021): revenue EUR 2.55B (-5% YoY pandemic effect). EBITDA EUR 168M. Sugar segment loss-making. Net income EUR 31M.
FY21/22 (ended Feb 28 2022): revenue EUR 2.93B (+15%). EBITDA EUR 207M. Recovery in Sugar segment, strong Fruit. Net income EUR 78M.
FY22/23 (ended Feb 28 2023): revenue EUR 3.64B (+24%) on energy/beet cost pass-through. EBITDA EUR 195M. Net income EUR 16M (margin pressure). Sugar swung positive on price.
FY23/24 (ended Feb 29 2024): revenue EUR 3.78B (+4%). EBITDA EUR 295M (+51%) on Sugar peak. Net income EUR 109M. Strong year for sugar segment, fruit margins recovering.
FY24/25 (ended Feb 28 2025): revenue EUR 3.57B (-6%) on EU sugar price normalization. EBITDA EUR 215M (-27%). Net income EUR 55M. Sugar segment back to mid-cycle.
